horizon_revision: The nonzero-memory start, kicked cycle and passive control missed the unchanged 1e-4 settlement gate at 1800 s. Their observation horizon was extended to 4200 s; original errors remain in initial_horizon_audit.
interpretation: Synthetic calibration parameters are fixed; sensor noise is added only to observations, not dynamics. The 5.7 s orbit is deliberately near twice this model's natural period. A 4 s orbit is a detuned control. Signed Kepler tidal-shaped inputs have equal time RMS, not physical lunar force or periods. Clay composition and Hug mechanics have not been measured. No added SIMS participant runs.
